content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Theresa Karner <terkarner@gmail.com>
Sent: Thursday, April 9, 2020 12:58 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Unforgettable student! 
 
Anthony, some students are just unforgettable and bring a smile to your face even after 20 years!  You are definitely one of them! I was always a huge Tiger fan growing up, and Al Kaline was my favorite (along with Rocky Callivito!) . So, today I was reading the Free Press Al Kaline Mr. Tiger and whose picture is staring at me???? Yours!! This is just such an uncertain time...and with Mr. Kaline passing away I was feeling a little sad and somber until I saw you!! My whole day brightened and brought me happiness and fun memories of you! I have always thought I was rich while being a teacher for over 30 years! But if I had only the privilege of teaching only you I would have been beyond blessed!! I still remember you vividly and remember that particular sunny day watching you play a baseball game as I sat with your dad! He thanked me for coming but it was I who was grateful and flattered that you had wanted me to see you play!  Also I remember the numerous time I read your essays and they always entertained me. I knew I could count on your insight and talent to make them wonderful! I also keep in my heart a time you stopped by to see me and I told you l always knew you were going to be so successful in life because you had the "right stuff".  I'm just so proud of you and honored to have been your life even for a short time...I thank you for making me rich! Again you have been and always will be unforgettable!  Also say hi to the rest of your family and your brothers....God Bless you!  Much love and respect!  P.S.When I told my husband I knew you he said to tell you he is a fan of yours! I'm starting to look impressive to my family LOL!! Thanks! Ter Karner
